headline: Istanbul decides to demolish more than 4,000 structures along the Bosphorus
summary: Istanbul authorities have launched a large-scale inspection of construction along the Bosphorus shores. Buildings deemed illegal or in breach of urban planning rules are slated for demolition, potentially affecting thousands of properties.
why: Enforcement of building rules in prime areas affects real estate values, construction activity and property owners' balance sheets.
